title: Edits to a listened-to graph keep connectivity queries current
summary: A graph listener accepted edits before the first full connectivity query. Reused and fresh inspectors agreed after adding an edge to a partially queried directed or undirected graph.

change.description: The inspector now handles vertex and edge notifications before all connected sets have been computed. An edge can also invalidate a component cached by a single-vertex query.

notes: The inspector defines weak connectivity for directed graphs. Query order and edge orientation cannot partition this underlying connected graph.
